messages:
Maya: Postmortem follow-up: thank you all. We surfaced recurring pager noise vs real incidents. Need clear owners + measurable outcomes for these alert-tuning items. Short thread to assign and record next steps.

Maya: Items: 1) noisy telemetry-exporter at night, 2) prediction-service mem thresholds causing flaps, 3) dedupe identical DB errors across AZs, 4) paging policy for low-impact alerts.

Aisha: I can take #1 (telemetry-exporter). Plan: run noise histogram by hour, add a low-priority suppression window 23:00-06:00 local, and reduce verbosity for known benign errors. Target: 2026-04-02.

Liam: I'll own #2 thresholds. Steps: extract 14-day OOM/flap events, propose 2 candidate thresholds, smoke test in canary, then apply. Will link a PR with metrics. Target: 2026-03-31.

Rob: Ill grab #3 dedupe infra and runbook. Idea: generate a canonical signature for errors (service + stacktrace fingerprint) and add a short dedupe window in alert-router. Also write runbook entries for when dedupe suppresses a new true-positive. Target: 2026-04-06.

Maya: For #4 paging policy, Id like to keep that as a cross-check with oncall rotation. Proposal: move "info/low" severity to channel-only from 22:00-07:00 and add a 10m flap suppression for repeated identical alerts. Who wants to draft the policy?

Rob: I can draft the paging policy doc, will include examples and rollback steps.

Aisha: Query Ill run for the exporter noise (PromQL):
```
sum by(hour) (increase(alerts_fired_total{alertname=~"Telemetry.*"}[7d]))
```
Ill attach the CSV output to the ticket.

Liam: Example threshold test plan:
- gather 14d metrics (RSS, GC pause, OOM count)
- create staging alerts with proposed thresholds
- monitor false positive rate for 72h
- promote if FP rate < 2%
Will post metrics snapshot.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFR-4590 and added checklist items: exporter-noise (Aisha) due 2026-04-02, prediction-thresholds (Liam) due 2026-03-31, dedupe-infra (Rob) due 2026-04-06, paging-policy (Rob) draft due 2026-03-29.

Maya: Measurement targets: nightly_pager_count (baseline), unique_alert_signatures, and median time-to-silence. Please add these metrics to each ticket as acceptance criteria.

Aisha: quick note  some exporter noise is from retries in the telemetry pipeline. Ill include a small fix to backoff + de-dupe on the exporter side rather than only on alerting.

Rob: For dedupe prototype Im thinking: signature = sha256(service + error_class + short_stackhash) and window=15m. Prototype config idea:
```
- name: cross-az-dedupe
  signature_fields: ["service", "error.class", "stack_hash:8"]
  window: 15m
```
Will include metrics to ensure we dont mask legitimate incidents.

Liam: If thresholds change, ensure metric names + tags are stable. Also add a revert play in the runbook with immediate rollback steps.

Maya: Good. Let's add a recurring "Alert Triage & Quality" 30-min sync every two weeks starting 2026-03-29. ops-bot please create calendar and add the ticket links.

ops-bot: Recurring meeting created: Alert Triage & Quality (biweekly) starting 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC. Links: INFR-4590.

Aisha: I'll attach exporter CSV and a short summary once I finish the hour-bucket runs.

Rob: I'll start a branch with the dedupe prototype and open an RFC in docs for feedback.

Liam: Running data pulls now, will drop findings and candidate thresholds by EOD Friday.

Maya: Thanks team. I'll notify Support and Product that we have owners + timelines and will close the loop after the first check-in. :thumbsup:
